9.   Transcript of Grades should be prepared on Legal or Folio size paper (on both
sides in a single sheet) . One extra copy of the Transcript of Grades is to be
submitted for office use in addition to required number of transcripts.
10.   Attested photocopies of Grade Cards of every appearance in each semester and
attested photocopy of Degree or Provisional certificate if obtained are to be
submitted along with the application and fee receipt.
11.   The fee for issue of the transcript of Grades is Rs. 1000/- per copy (subject to
change).
